Player Impressions:
Hoyos - nothing outstanding in this half.  couldn't stop the goal.  Charlotte with only 1 shot on target this half
Jacob - a wasteful night.  was clearly pushed up the pitch.  BUt provided nothing in attack.  His crosses hurt the team more than they helped
Díaz - some real intelligent play in defense.  works very hard and already seems to care deeply.  He wasn't able to connect with the midfield to start counters.
Alonso - ineffective due to his and Charlotte's speed difference
Edwards - good not great.  Which puts him as the best defender as he was providing output up the pitch
Sanchez - had a few moments, but it wasn't his best game.  kept quiet by Charlotte
Reilly - Seems to have hit his level.  Gill is clearly the bettter midfielder.  He may have seen his last game for a while
Muyumba - gave away several balls.  had maybe one shot.  
Miranchuk - Frustrating to watch him tonight.  Had some bad plays and looked out of sorts.  He seemed out of gas which is odd as they had the full week off
Picault - another quiet game.  Charlotte knew how to mark him.  He kept going deeper and deeper to get involved.  Couldn't get the ball to connect with the front line.
Almirón - This was the Miguel of prior to the world cup.  Slow, inefective crosses.  uninspiring.  
Gill - A vast improvement in midfield. Able to read the ball movement really well.  It's difficult to get a ball past him.
Hernández - called in with little notice and put into his unnatural position.  couldn't cope with the Charlotte winger, but no one could
Alzate - brought in to try and stabilize midfield.  wasn't able to, and looked clumsy in attack
Santos - The only positive thing I remember were two side footed flicks out to the wing.  Otherwise, easily knocked off the ball, to the ground.  Even slipped.
Dovlo - a positive debut.  Looked hungry and got in some crosses.  Increased the quality of attack.
